evals.name: web-primary-vs-detail-count
evals.prompt:
Plan the image-generation workflow only. The described assets are hypothetical; no input files or generation tools are provided in this exercise. State the required inputs, image-set contract, preservation checks, and completion boundary without claiming any artifact exists:

Create design-reference images for exactly three horizontal sections of a synthetic field-notes product site: hero, collection browser, and final signup. Make each section readable for implementation. Add a close detail only if one component genuinely needs it, and make clear what counts toward the section total.
evals.expected_output: Plans, rather than claims to execute: Uses the documented available image generator and returns three separately inspectable horizontal primary images, one per named section. Any useful close-up is separately labeled as a detail and excluded from the primary count. The sequence varies composition while retaining one coherent product system, contains no invented proof, and includes the image-only handoff and actual-output inspection; if generation is unavailable, it reports that instead of fabricating artifacts or code.
expectations: In the plan: Declares and delivers exactly three primary horizontal section images; does not collapse sections into a tall page or contact sheet.
In the plan: Labels optional close-ups as details outside the primary count and never uses one to replace a primary.
In the plan: Inspects actual outputs and reports paths, viewport, preserved/proposed content, and unknown behavior without implementing code.
Does not claim images were generated or visually inspected in this planning-only exercise.

evals.name: native-mobile-platform-scope
evals.prompt:
Plan the image-generation workflow only. The described assets are hypothetical; no input files or generation tools are provided in this exercise. State the required inputs, image-set contract, preservation checks, and completion boundary without claiming any artifact exists:

Generate a four-screen Android-native concept for a synthetic neighborhood tool-share app: browse, item detail, request sheet, and confirmation. Keep it buildable, readable, and consistent. This is a native app, not a responsive website, and this phase must produce images only.
evals.expected_output: Plans, rather than claims to execute: Selects Android-native patterns, safe areas, navigation and device framing intentionally; produces a coherent four-screen flow with readable separate outputs and actual inspection. It does not substitute iOS cues, a phone-sized website, source code, or unsupported interaction claims.
expectations: In the plan: Produces the four requested Android-native screen roles in a logical sequence with consistent state and design language.
In the plan: Accounts for Android navigation, safe areas/system insets, readable controls, and coherent device presentation while distinguishing the result from responsive web.
In the plan: Returns inspected image artifacts and an image-only handoff; unavailable generation is reported rather than faked.
Does not claim images were generated or visually inspected in this planning-only exercise.

evals.name: brand-preservation-concept-delivery
evals.prompt:
Plan the image-generation workflow only. The described assets are hypothetical; no input files or generation tools are provided in this exercise. State the required inputs, image-set contract, preservation checks, and completion boundary without claiming any artifact exists:

Using the supplied owned logo, wordmark, forest/cream palette, and type specimen, create one identity concept board for a fictional community seed library. Preserve those assets exactly and propose only image direction and two coherent applications. Deliver a concept board only; do not claim vector masters, font files, tokens, trademark clearance, or print-ready assets.
evals.expected_output: Plans, rather than claims to execute: Treats supplied identity assets as authoritative inputs, preserves and visually compares them, and limits proposals to image direction and two coherent applications tied to a core metaphor. The handoff distinguishes preserved from proposed material and explicitly excludes absent vector, font, token, legal, and production deliverables.
expectations: In the plan: Uses documented input-image support when available and checks the generated logo/wordmark against the supplied owned source; any preservation limitation prevents an approved claim.
In the plan: Builds a coherent concept board with brand strategy/core metaphor, functional palette/type/image direction, and the two requested applications.
In the plan: Returns an inspected concept image and does not represent generated pixels as production-ready vector, font, token, legal, or print assets.
Does not claim images were generated or visually inspected in this planning-only exercise.

evals.name: negative-generic-image-scope
evals.prompt: Generate a photorealistic image of a red fox crossing a snowy meadow for a nature article. No interface, app, website, or brand identity board is involved.
evals.expected_output: Does not invoke the imagegen UI/brand-board workflow; routes the generic photo request to the environment's general image-generation capability without loading frontend or brandkit branches.
expectations: Recognizes that a generic editorial photo is outside this skill's web/mobile UI and brand-board scope.
Does not apply section, screen-flow, device, or brand-board contracts to the request.

evals.name: responsive-web-not-native
evals.prompt: Plan one primary reference image for a 390px-wide portrait responsive website signup section. It is not a native app. No image tools are provided; do not generate or claim an artifact. Explain branch, orientation, count and verification boundary.
evals.expected_output: Uses the web branch with one portrait primary at the requested phone-width viewport, no native-app conventions or forced horizontal desktop canvas, and no invented generation.
expectations: Selects the web branch and respects the requested portrait orientation and one primary image.
Does not impose native navigation or claim responsive behavior can be proved by static pixels.
Does not claim generation or inspection occurred.
